questions.text: Is there a crossing facility available at this location?
Would you like a crossing facility to be provided at this location?
Is the crossing facility also for bicycles?
How many traffic lanes (in total) do you need to cross?
How visible are the markings (signage) for this crossing facility?

options.text: No visible crossing markings on the road
Crossing markings are faded or worn out
Crossing markings are clear, but visibility is blocked by traffic congestion
Crossing markings are clear, but often obstructed by vehicles waiting at traffic lights

questions.text: Which safety features are available at this crossing? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Raised crossing (higher than the road surface)
Unprotected waiting area in the middle of the road
Protected waiting area in the middle of the road (refuge island)

questions.text: Does something make it difficult to see approaching traffic or the crossing itself? (Select all that apply)
When you want to cross, how often do drivers give you the way?

options.text: Drivers rarely stop; I usually wait for a gap in traffic.
Some drivers stop, while others continue driving.
Most drivers stop when they see me waiting to cross.
Drivers almost always stop, allowing me to cross immediately.

questions.text: How long do you usually wait before you can cross?

options.text: I can usually cross immediately (less than 10 seconds)
A very long wait (more than 2 minutes)

questions.text: Is the waiting time indicated acceptable to you?
How adequate is the waiting space at the crossing?

options.text: Too small for the number of people using it

questions.text: Which accessibility features apply to this crossing? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Tactile paving for visually impaired people

questions.text: Does the bridge have any cover?

options.text: Covered by a roof or canopy
Covered by walls or an enclosed structure
Covered by glass or transparent panels

questions.text: Which of the following apply to the underpass/tunnel? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Walking surface is clean and free of litter
Walls and ceiling are in good condition

questions.text: How safe would you feel using this underpass/tunnel?

options.text: Very safe – the underpass is well lit, visibility is clear, and it appears clean and maintained.
Mostly safe – the underpass has adequate lighting and visibility, with only minor concerns.
Neutral – the underpass is usable, but some safety conditions are uncertain.
Somewhat unsafe – one or more conditions such as poor lighting, limited visibility, litter, or damp areas reduce the feeling of safety.
Very unsafe – the underpass has major safety concerns and would feel unsafe to use.

questions.text: How safe would you feel using this bridge/overpass?

options.text: Very safe – the bridge is well lit, visibility is clear, and protective railings are secure.
Mostly safe – the bridge has adequate lighting and secure railings, with only minor concerns.
Neutral – the bridge is usable, but some safety conditions are uncertain.
Somewhat unsafe – one or more conditions such as poor lighting, limited visibility, or inadequate railings reduce the feeling of safety.
Very unsafe – the bridge has major safety concerns and would feel unsafe to use.
